axes_units: X-axis: Years from 2000 to 2022; Y-axis: Birth rate (per 1000 adolescent girls) for two age groups: 15–19 years (0 to 140 scale) and 10–14 years (0 to 10 scale)
summary: The figure shows declining trends in adolescent birth rates from 2000 to 2022 across all WHO regions for both age groups 15–19 years and 10–14 years. The African Region consistently has the highest birth rates in both age groups, while the European and Western Pacific Regions have the lowest. The South-East Asia Region shows a sharp decline, especially in the 15–19 years group. Overall, birth rates among younger adolescents (10–14 years) are much lower than those among older adolescents (15–19 years).
